div.head: Iud Dei X 20.1
div.ab: ita ut, si innocens de hoc furto, unde purgatio quaerenda est, in hanc aquam tua benedictione sanctificatam corpus suum immittere uoluerit, tua benignissima miseratione confestim ab ista excipiatur aqua et postmodum illaesus appareat.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 418 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Gekünstelter Ausdruck durch unvollkommenes Umarbeiten der Feuerordal-Formel. Vgl. o. S. 411{29}.
An artificial expression resulting from incomplete reworking of the fire-ordeal formula. Cf. above p. 411{29}.
